# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gradio UI Construction
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

QUICK_PROMPTS = [
    ("📦 Where is ORD1001?", "Where is my order ORD1001?"),
    ("🛒 Buy Headphones", "I'd like to order 2 Wireless Noise-Cancel Headphones. My name is Alex Kumar, pay with UPI."),
    ("❌ Cancel ORD1003", "Cancel my order ORD1003 please."),
    ("🔄 Return ORD1008", "I would like to return the Denim Jacket from order ORD1008."),
    ("🛍️ Browse Electronics", "Show me all electronics products available in your store."),
    ("📝 Modify ORD1016", "Change the quantity of the 4K Smart TV in order ORD1016 to 2."),
    ("📜 Return Policy", "What is your warranty and return window policy for electronics?"),
    ("🛡️ Trap: ORD9999", "Where is my order ORD9999? Track it for me."),
]

def build_ui() -> gr.Blocks:
    """Build the modern 3-tab Gradio user interface."""
    
    with gr.Blocks(title="ShopEase AI — Customer Service Bot") as app:
        
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Hero Header Banner
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        gr.HTML("""
        <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 27, 75, 0.95) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); border-radius: 20px; padding: 22px 28px; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.3);">
            <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px;">
                <div>
                    <h1 style="margin: 0; font-size: 2.1rem; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a5b4fc 0%, #c084fc 50%, #38bdf8 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;">
                        🛍️ ShopEase AI
                    </h1>
                    <p style="margin: 4px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 500;">
                        Autonomous Customer Support Agent with <strong>ReAct Multi-Step Reasoning</strong> & <strong>TF-IDF RAG Grounding</strong>
                    </p>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center;">
                    <span class="live-indicator"><span class="pulse-dot"></span> System Online</span>
                    <span style="background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); color: #a5b4fc; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;">⚡ Groq Qwen 27B / Gemini Flash</span>
                    <span style="background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3); color: #c084fc; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600;">🛡️ 0% Hallucination RAG</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        """)
        
        with gr.Tabs():
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            # Tab 1: Chat Interface
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            with gr.Tab("💬 Interactive Chat", id="chat-tab"):
                with gr.Row():
                    # Left Sidebar: Engine Configuration & Quick Reference
                    with gr.Column(scale=1):
                        gr.HTML("<h3 style='margin: 0 0 10px 0; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #f8fafc; font-weight: 700;'>⚙️ Agent Configuration</h3>")
                        
                        provider_dropdown = gr.Dropdown(
                            choices=["Groq", "Gemini", "OpenAI"],
                            value="Groq",
                            label="Model Provider",
                            info="Groq (Qwen 27B, sub-second) or Gemini (2.5 Flash)",
                        )
                        
                        version_dropdown = gr.Dropdown(
                            choices=list_versions(),
                            value="V6 — RAG + ReAct",
                            label="Prompt Version",
                            info="Select iteration (V1 naive to V6 grounded)",
                        )
                        
                        # Live Version Explainer Card
                        version_card_box = gr.HTML(value=render_version_card("V6 — RAG + ReAct"))
                        
                        temp_slider = gr.Slider(
                            minimum=0.0,
                            maximum=1.0,
                            value=0.3,
                            step=0.1,
                            label="Sampling Temperature",
                            info="Lower = deterministic tool calling; Higher = creative",
                        )
                        
                        # When version changes -> auto-update card and recommended temp
                        def on_version_change(v):
                            card = render_version_card(v)
                            rec_temp = get_recommended_temp(v)
                            return card, rec_temp
                        
                        version_dropdown.change(
                            fn=on_version_change,
                            inputs=[version_dropdown],
                            outputs=[version_card_box, temp_slider],
                        )
                        
                        # Collapsible Quick Knowledge Cheatsheet
                        with gr.Accordion("🏬 Mock Database Reference", open=False):
                            gr.Markdown("""
                            **Mock Orders for Testing:**
                            - `ORD1001` — Delivered (Headphones)
                            - `ORD1002` — Shipped (Smart Watch)
                            - `ORD1003` — Processing (Espresso Beans)
                            - `ORD1008` — Delivered (Denim Jacket, returnable)
                            - `ORD1009` — Delivered (Food item, non-returnable)
                            - `ORD9999` — Fake Order (Adversarial Trap)
                            
                            **Catalog Highlights:**
                            - `UltraBook Pro 14` (₹1,099.99)
                            - `Noise-Canceling Headphones` (₹79.99)
                            - `AeroFit Running Shoes` (₹119.00)
                            """)
                        
                        with gr.Accordion("🔧 Active Store Tools (9 Tools)", open=False):
                            gr.Markdown("""
                            **📖 Query Tools:**
                            1. `get_order_status(order_id)`
                            2. `get_product_info(product_id_or_name)`
                            3. `search_policy(query)` — RAG
                            4. `list_products(category)` — Browse catalog
                            
                            **🔄 Action Tools:**
                            5. `place_order(customer_name, product_id, qty, payment_method)` — 🆕 Place real orders
                            6. `cancel_order(order_id)` — 🆕 Cancel & refund
                            7. `modify_order(order_id, product_id, new_qty)` — 🆕 Change order qty
                            8. `initiate_return(order_id, product_id)`
                            9. `calculate_refund(order_id, product_id)`
                            """)
                    
                    # Right Main Column: Chat Arena + Quick Starter Chips
                    with gr.Column(scale=3):
                        chatbot = gr.Chatbot(
                            label="Customer Support Conversation",
                            height=520,
                            avatar_images=(None, "https://em-content.zobj.net/source/twitter/408/robot_1f916.png"),
                        )
                        
                        # Quick Starter Suggestion Chips
                        gr.HTML("<div style='font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 6px 0 4px 2px;'>⚡ Instant Test Queries (Click to Run):</div>")
                        
                        with gr.Row():
                            chip1 = gr.Button("📦 Where is ORD1001?", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip2 = gr.Button("🛒 Buy Headphones", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip3 = gr.Button("❌ Cancel ORD1003", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip4 = gr.Button("🔄 Return ORD1008", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                        with gr.Row():
                            chip5 = gr.Button("🛍️ Browse Electronics", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip6 = gr.Button("📝 Modify ORD1016", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip7 = gr.Button("📜 Return Policy", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                            chip8 = gr.Button("🛡️ Trap: ORD9999", elem_classes=["chip-btn"])
                        
                        with gr.Row():
                            msg_input = gr.Textbox(
                                placeholder="Ask about your order, return policies, product specs, or shipping...",
                                label="Your Message",
                                scale=5,
                                show_label=False,
                                container=False,
                            )
                            send_btn = gr.Button("Send 📤", variant="primary", scale=1)
                            clear_btn = gr.Button("🗑️ Clear", variant="secondary", scale=1)
                
                # Chat logic
                def respond(message, history, version, provider, temperature):
                    if not message or not message.strip():
                        return history or [], ""
                    
                    bot_response = chat_handler(message, history, version, provider, temperature)
                    current_history = list(history) if history else []
                    current_history.append({"role": "user", "content": message})
                    current_history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": bot_response})
                    return current_history, ""
                
                send_btn.click(
                    fn=respond,
                    inputs=[msg_input, chatbot, version_dropdown, provider_dropdown, temp_slider],
                    outputs=[chatbot, msg_input],
                )
                msg_input.submit(
                    fn=respond,
                    inputs=[msg_input, chatbot, version_dropdown, provider_dropdown, temp_slider],
                    outputs=[chatbot, msg_input],
                )
                clear_btn.click(lambda: ([], ""), outputs=[chatbot, msg_input])
                
                # Wire up Quick Suggestion Chips
                chips = [chip1, chip2, chip3, chip4, chip5, chip6, chip7, chip8]
                for btn, (label, query_text) in zip(chips, QUICK_PROMPTS):
                    btn.click(
                        fn=lambda q=query_text: q,
                        outputs=[msg_input],
                    ).then(
                        fn=respond,
                        inputs=[msg_input, chatbot, version_dropdown, provider_dropdown, temp_slider],
                        outputs=[chatbot, msg_input],
                    )

            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            # Tab 2: Prompt Inspector
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            with gr.Tab("🔍 Prompt & Reasoning Inspector", id="inspector-tab"):
                gr.HTML("""
                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px;">
                    <div>
                        <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc;">Execution Transparency & Telemetry</h3>
                        <p style="margin: 2px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.88rem;">Inspect live prompt tokens, raw model answers, and step-by-step ReAct thought traces.</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                """)
                
                refresh_btn = gr.Button("🔄 Refresh Telemetry & Traces", variant="primary")
                
                # Top KPI Grid
                kpi_box = gr.HTML(value="""
                <div style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2); border-radius: 14px; padding: 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: center; color: #94a3b8;">
                    Click <strong>'Refresh Telemetry & Traces'</strong> after sending a chat message to inspect execution telemetry.
                </div>
                """)
                
                gr.HTML("<h4 style='margin: 16px 0 8px 0; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 1rem;'>🔄 ReAct Execution Timeline (Tool Calls & Observations)</h4>")
                trace_display = gr.HTML(value="<div style='color: #64748b;'>No execution trace loaded yet.</div>")
                
                with gr.Row():
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='margin: 12px 0 6px 0; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.95rem;'>📄 Full Prompt Sent to LLM (with RAG Context)</h4>")
                        prompt_display = gr.Textbox(
                            label="",
                            lines=14,
                            max_lines=28,
                            interactive=False,
                            show_label=False,
                        )
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='margin: 12px 0 6px 0; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 0.95rem;'>🤖 Raw LLM Output(s)</h4>")
                        raw_display = gr.Textbox(
                            label="",
                            lines=14,
                            max_lines=28,
                            interactive=False,
                            show_label=False,
                        )
                
                # Side-by-Side Prompt Version Diff
                with gr.Accordion("🔍 Side-by-Side Prompt Version Diff (difflib)", open=False):
                    gr.Markdown("Compare prompt structure and directives between any two versions (e.g. V5 ReAct vs V6 RAG):")
                    with gr.Row():
                        diff_v1 = gr.Dropdown(choices=list_versions(), value="V5 — ReAct", label="Base Version (A)", scale=2)
                        diff_v2 = gr.Dropdown(choices=list_versions(), value="V6 — RAG + ReAct", label="Target Version (B)", scale=2)
                        diff_btn = gr.Button("Compare Prompt Templates ⚖️", variant="primary", scale=1)
                    diff_output = gr.HTML(value="<div style='color: #64748b; padding: 12px;'>Select two prompt versions above and click Compare to render side-by-side diff.</div>")
                    
                    diff_btn.click(
                        fn=get_prompt_diff_html,
                        inputs=[diff_v1, diff_v2],
                        outputs=[diff_output],
                    )

                refresh_btn.click(
                    fn=get_inspector_data,
                    outputs=[prompt_display, raw_display, trace_display, kpi_box],
                )

            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            # Tab 3: Evaluation Dashboard
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            with gr.Tab("📊 Evaluation Dashboard", id="eval-tab"):
                gr.HTML("""
                <div style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc;">📊 Evaluation & Real-Time Performance Dashboard</h3>
                    <p style="margin: 3px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.92rem;">
                        Real-time live conversation stream, interactive test suite executor, and systematic prompt refinement benchmarks (V1–V6).
                    </p>
                </div>
                """)
                
                # ===============================================================
                # PART 1: Real-Time Live Chat Telemetry (Stream Active)
                # ===============================================================
                live_kpi_box = gr.HTML(value=format_live_kpi_html())
                
                with gr.Row():
                    refresh_live_btn = gr.Button("🔄 Refresh Live Stream & Metrics", variant="primary", scale=2)
                    clear_live_btn = gr.Button("🗑️ Clear Live Session Logs", variant="secondary", scale=1)
                
                with gr.Accordion("📝 Live Interaction Stream & Conversation Logs", open=True):
                    live_table_display = gr.Markdown(value=format_live_table_markdown())
                
                gr.HTML("<hr style='border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); margin: 24px 0;' />")

                # ===============================================================
                # PART 1.5: SQLite Production Telemetry Aggregates (Excludes Demo Mode)
                # ===============================================================
                with gr.Accordion("🗄️ SQLite Production Telemetry Aggregates (Excludes Demo Mode)", open=False):
                    gr.Markdown("Real-time aggregates per prompt version computed directly from `data/shopease.db` (telemetry_runs):")
                    telemetry_table = gr.Markdown(value=get_telemetry_summary_markdown())
                    refresh_telem_btn = gr.Button("🔄 Refresh SQLite Telemetry Aggregates", variant="secondary")
                    refresh_telem_btn.click(fn=get_telemetry_summary_markdown, outputs=[telemetry_table])

                gr.HTML("<hr style='border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); margin: 24px 0;' />")

                # ===============================================================
                # PART 2: Interactive Benchmark Runner (Run Test Suite Live)
                # ===============================================================
                gr.HTML("""
                <div style="margin-bottom: 14px;">
                    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                        <h4 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc;">⚡ Run Benchmark Test Suite in Real-Time</h4>
                        <span style="background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5); color: #a5b4fc; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px;">LIVE EXECUTION</span>
                    </div>
                    <p style="margin: 3px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.88rem;">
                        Execute standardized customer service test queries against the model in real time. Results automatically update the benchmark database and comparison charts.
                    </p>
                </div>
                """)
                
                with gr.Row():
                    bench_version_selector = gr.Dropdown(
                        choices=["V6 — RAG + ReAct", "V5 — ReAct", "V4 — Chain-of-Thought", "V3 — Few-Shot", "V2 — Role + Rules", "V1 — Naive", "All Versions (V1–V6)"],
                        value="V6 — RAG + ReAct",
                        label="Target Prompt Version",
                        scale=2,
                    )
                    bench_scope_selector = gr.Radio(
                        choices=["Quick Smoke Test (5 Queries: Q01, Q04, Q07, Q10, Q13)", "Full Test Suite (15 Queries: Q01–Q15)"],
                        value="Quick Smoke Test (5 Queries: Q01, Q04, Q07, Q10, Q13)",
                        label="Evaluation Scope",
                        scale=3,
                    )
                    bench_provider_selector = gr.Dropdown(
                        choices=["groq", "gemini", "openai"],
                        value="groq",
                        label="Backend Provider",
                        scale=1,
                    )
                
                run_bench_btn = gr.Button("⚡ Run Benchmark Suite Now", variant="primary")
                bench_status_display = gr.Markdown("Ready to execute live benchmark. Click above to run.")

                gr.HTML("<hr style='border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); margin: 24px 0;' />")

                # ===============================================================
                # PART 3: Systematic Benchmark Performance Cards & Charts (V1–V6)
                # ===============================================================
                gr.HTML("""
                <div style="margin-bottom: 14px;">
                    <h4 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc;">📈 Systematic Benchmark Metrics & Comparison Charts</h4>
                    <p style="margin: 3px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.88rem;">
                        Empirical comparison across standardized queries showing the iterative improvement from V1 (Zero-Shot) to V6 (RAG + ReAct).
                    </p>
                </div>
                """)
                
                bench_kpi_box = gr.HTML(value=compute_benchmark_kpi_html())
                
                reload_charts_btn = gr.Button("🔄 Reload Saved Benchmark Results & Charts", variant="secondary")
                
                chart_image = gr.Image(
                    label="Comparative Benchmark Charts (Task Success, Tool Accuracy, Hallucination Prevention, Latency)",
                    type="filepath",
                    value=str(EVAL_DIR / "eval_charts.png") if (EVAL_DIR / "eval_charts.png").exists() else None,
                )
                
                with gr.Accordion("📋 Detailed Evaluation Query Matrix (Q01–Q15)", open=False):
                    results_table = gr.Markdown(value=load_results_csv())

                # Live stream event hooks
                def refresh_live_stream():
                    return format_live_kpi_html(), format_live_table_markdown()

                def clear_live_stream():
                    clear_live_logs()
                    return format_live_kpi_html(), format_live_table_markdown()

                refresh_live_btn.click(
                    fn=refresh_live_stream,
                    outputs=[live_kpi_box, live_table_display],
                )
                clear_live_btn.click(
                    fn=clear_live_stream,
                    outputs=[live_kpi_box, live_table_display],
                )

                # Live benchmark runner hook
                run_bench_btn.click(
                    fn=run_live_benchmark_ui,
                    inputs=[bench_version_selector, bench_provider_selector, bench_scope_selector],
                    outputs=[bench_status_display, bench_kpi_box, results_table, chart_image],
                )

                # Static refresh hook
                def refresh_eval():
                    table_md = load_results_csv()
                    chart_path = generate_eval_charts()
                    kpi_html = compute_benchmark_kpi_html()
                    return kpi_html, table_md, chart_path

                reload_charts_btn.click(
                    fn=refresh_eval,
                    outputs=[bench_kpi_box, results_table, chart_image],
                )

            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            # Tab 4: A/B Testing Arena
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------
            with gr.Tab("⚖️ A/B Testing", id="ab-tab"):
                gr.HTML("""
                <div style="margin-bottom: 16px;">
                    <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc;">⚖️ Concurrent Model A/B Testing Arena</h3>
                    <p style="margin: 3px 0 0 0; color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.92rem;">
                        Dispatch one prompt concurrently to two versions/temperatures. Compare answers, reasoning traces, latency, and tokens side-by-side, then vote on the preferred output.
                    </p>
                </div>
                """)

                with gr.Row():
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='color: #818cf8; margin: 0 0 6px 0;'>🤖 Model Configuration A</h4>")
                        ab_ver_a = gr.Dropdown(choices=list_versions(), value="V5 — ReAct", label="Model A Version")
                        ab_temp_a = gr.Slider(minimum=0.0, maximum=1.0, value=0.3, step=0.1, label="Model A Temperature")
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='color: #34d399; margin: 0 0 6px 0;'>🤖 Model Configuration B</h4>")
                        ab_ver_b = gr.Dropdown(choices=list_versions(), value="V6 — RAG + ReAct", label="Model B Version")
                        ab_temp_b = gr.Slider(minimum=0.0, maximum=1.0, value=0.3, step=0.1, label="Model B Temperature")

                ab_provider = gr.Dropdown(choices=["groq", "gemini", "openai"], value="groq", label="Inference Provider")

                with gr.Row():
                    ab_prompt_input = gr.Textbox(
                        placeholder="Enter any customer query to test side-by-side (e.g. Can I return my electronics order ORD1013?)...",
                        label="Evaluation Prompt",
                        scale=5,
                    )
                    ab_run_btn = gr.Button("⚡ Run A/B Comparison", variant="primary", scale=1)

                ab_status = gr.Markdown("Ready to compare. Enter a query and click Run.")

                with gr.Row():
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='color: #818cf8;'>Output A</h4>")
                        ab_ans_a = gr.Markdown(value="*Awaiting execution...*")
                        with gr.Accordion("🔍 Model A ReAct Trace", open=False):
                            ab_trace_a = gr.Textbox(label="", lines=6, interactive=False)
                    with gr.Column():
                        gr.HTML("<h4 style='color: #34d399;'>Output B</h4>")
                        ab_ans_b = gr.Markdown(value="*Awaiting execution...*")
                        with gr.Accordion("🔍 Model B ReAct Trace", open=False):
                            ab_trace_b = gr.Textbox(label="", lines=6, interactive=False)

                gr.HTML("<div style='margin-top: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #cbd5e1;'>🗳️ Cast Your Human Preference Vote:</div>")
                with gr.Row():
                    vote_a_btn = gr.Button("👍 Model A is Better", variant="secondary")
                    vote_b_btn = gr.Button("👍 Model B is Better", variant="secondary")
                    vote_tie_btn = gr.Button("🤝 It's a Tie", variant="secondary")

                vote_status = gr.Markdown("")

                # Win-count summary
                def render_ab_summary_html() -> str:
                    s = get_ab_summary()
                    tot = s["Total"]
                    if tot == 0:
                        return """
                        <div style="text-align: center; padding: 16px; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;">
                            no votes recorded yet
                        </div>
                        """
                    p_a = round((s["A"] / tot) * 100, 1) if tot else 0
                    p_b = round((s["B"] / tot) * 100, 1) if tot else 0
                    p_tie = round((s["Tie"] / tot) * 100, 1) if tot else 0
                    return f"""
                    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 12px 0;">

                ab_state = gr.State({})

                def run_ab_comparison_ui(prompt, v_a, t_a, v_b, t_b, provider):
                    if not prompt or not prompt.strip():
                        return "Please enter a test query.", "", "", "", "Ready", {}
                    
                    ok, msg = validate_input_length(prompt)
                    if not ok:
                        return f"⚠️ {msg}", "", "", "", "Invalid Input", {}
                    
                    clean_prompt, _ = redact_pii(prompt)
                    
                    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
                        f_a = executor.submit(
                            run_react_loop,
                            user_message=clean_prompt,
                            chat_history=[],
                            version=v_a,
                            provider=provider.lower(),
                            temperature=t_a,
                        )
                        f_b = executor.submit(
                            run_react_loop,
                            user_message=clean_prompt,
                            chat_history=[],
                            version=v_b,
                            provider=provider.lower(),
                            temperature=t_b,
                        )
                        res_a = f_a.result()
                        res_b = f_b.result()

                    cost_a = calculate_cost_usd(provider, res_a.get("model", ""), res_a["total_tokens"]["prompt_tokens"], res_a["total_tokens"]["completion_tokens"])
                    cost_b = calculate_cost_usd(provider, res_b.get("model", ""), res_b["total_tokens"]["prompt_tokens"], res_b["total_tokens"]["completion_tokens"])

                    saved_state = {
                        "prompt": clean_prompt,
                        "version_a": v_a,
                        "temp_a": t_a,
                        "version_b": v_b,
                        "temp_b": t_b,
                        "answer_a": res_a.get("answer", ""),
                        "answer_b": res_b.get("answer", ""),
                    }

                    badge_a = (
                        f"**Model A ({v_a})** — ⏱️ {res_a.get('total_latency_ms', 0):.0f} ms | "
                        f"🪙 {res_a['total_tokens']['total_tokens']} tokens\n\n"
                    )
                    badge_b = (
                        f"**Model B ({v_b})** — ⏱️ {res_b.get('total_latency_ms', 0):.0f} ms | "
                        f"🪙 {res_b['total_tokens']['total_tokens']} tokens\n\n"
                    )

                    trace_a_str = "\n".join(
                        f"[{s['iteration']}] {s['thought']} -> {s['action']} (Input: {json.dumps(s.get('action_input', {}))}) -> {s.get('observation', '')[:120]}"
                        for s in res_a.get("trace", [])
                    )
                    trace_b_str = "\n".join(
                        f"[{s['iteration']}] {s['thought']} -> {s['action']} (Input: {json.dumps(s.get('action_input', {}))}) -> {s.get('observation', '')[:120]}"
                        for s in res_b.get("trace", [])
                    )

                    return (
                        badge_a + res_a.get("answer", ""),
                        trace_a_str,
                        badge_b + res_b.get("answer", ""),
                        trace_b_str,
                        "✅ Execution complete! Cast your vote below:",
                        saved_state,
                    )

                ab_run_btn.click(
                    fn=run_ab_comparison_ui,
                    inputs=[ab_prompt_input, ab_ver_a, ab_temp_a, ab_ver_b, ab_temp_b, ab_provider],
                    outputs=[ab_ans_a, ab_trace_a, ab_ans_b, ab_trace_b, ab_status, ab_state],
                )

                def vote_action(choice: str, state: dict):
                    if not state or not state.get("prompt"):
                        return "⚠️ Please run an A/B comparison query before voting.", render_ab_summary_html()
                    log_ab_vote(
                        prompt=state["prompt"],
                        version_a=state["version_a"],
                        temp_a=state["temp_a"],
                        version_b=state["version_b"],
                        temp_b=state["temp_b"],
                        answer_a=state["answer_a"],
                        answer_b=state["answer_b"],
                        vote=choice,
                    )
                    return f"🎉 Vote recorded: **{choice}**", render_ab_summary_html()

                vote_a_btn.click(
                    fn=lambda s: vote_action("A", s),
                    inputs=[ab_state],
                    outputs=[vote_status, ab_summary_box],
                )
                vote_b_btn.click(
                    fn=lambda s: vote_action("B", s),
                    inputs=[ab_state],
                    outputs=[vote_status, ab_summary_box],
                )
                vote_tie_btn.click(
                    fn=lambda s: vote_action("Tie", s),
                    inputs=[ab_state],
                    outputs=[vote_status, ab_summary_box],
                )

                def do_export_csv():
                    out_path = export_ab_log_csv()
                    return out_path

                export_csv_btn.click(fn=do_export_csv, outputs=[export_file])
        
        # Footer
        gr.HTML("""
        <div style="text-align: center; padding: 20px 0 10px 0; color: #64748b; font-size: 0.85rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); margin-top: 24px;">
            ShopEase AI v2.0 • Autonomous ReAct Engine • Multi-Provider Inference (Groq / Gemini / OpenAI) • Iterative Prompt Engineering
        </div>
        """)

"""
Parameter Sensitivity Experiment:
Runs Prompt V6 across the 15 standardized evaluation queries at temperature 0.0 and 0.7.
Saves empirical measurements to eval/param_results.csv.

Usage:
    python eval/param_test.py [--provider groq] [--delay 1.0]
"""

import sys
import json
import csv
import time
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

# Add project root to path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent))

from eval.run_eval import load_test_queries, evaluate_single

EVAL_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
PARAM_RESULTS_CSV = EVAL_DIR / "param_results.csv"


def run_param_experiment(
    provider: str = "groq",
    temperatures: list[float] | None = None,
    delay: float = 1.0,
    output_path: Path = PARAM_RESULTS_CSV,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Execute V6 prompt at different temperatures across 15 benchmark queries."""
    if temperatures is None:
        temperatures = [0.0, 0.3, 0.7]

    queries = load_test_queries()
    version = "V6 — RAG + ReAct"
    all_results = []

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("ShopEase AI — Parameter Sensitivity Experiment (Temperature 0.0 vs 0.7)")
    print(f"Provider: {provider} | Target Version: {version}")
    print(f"Temperatures: {temperatures} | Total Runs: {len(temperatures) * len(queries)}")
    print("=" * 70 + "\n")

    for temp in temperatures:
        print(f"\n--- Running Temperature = {temp} ---")
        for i, q in enumerate(queries, 1):
            print(f"  [{i}/{len(queries)}] {q['id']} ({q['category']}): {q['query'][:45]}...", end=" ", flush=True)
            res = evaluate_single(
                query=q,
                version=version,
                provider=provider,
                temperature=temp,
            )
            # Annotate with temperature tested
            res["temperature"] = temp
            all_results.append(res)

            status = "[OK]" if res["task_success"] else "[FAIL]"
            halluc = " [HALLUC]" if res["hallucination"] else ""
            print(f"{status} ({res['latency_ms']}ms){halluc}")

            if delay > 0:
                time.sleep(delay)

        # Incrementally save after each temperature
        fieldnames = [
            "query_id", "category", "version", "provider", "temperature",
            "task_success", "tool_accuracy", "hallucination", "ungrounded", "correct",
            "latency_ms", "tools_called", "answer", "note"
        ]
        with open(output_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames, extrasaction="ignore")
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(all_results)
        print(f"  [saved {len(all_results)} cumulative results for T={temp}]")

    print(f"\n✅ All results saved to {output_path}")

    # Print summary
    print_summary(all_results)
    return all_results


def print_summary(results: list[dict]):
    """Print comparative table by temperature."""
    from collections import defaultdict
    stats = defaultdict(lambda: {"total": 0, "success": 0, "tool_acc": 0, "halluc": 0, "latency": []})

    for r in results:
        t = r["temperature"]
        stats[t]["total"] += 1
        stats[t]["success"] += r["task_success"]
        stats[t]["tool_acc"] += r["tool_accuracy"]
        stats[t]["halluc"] += r["hallucination"]
        stats[t]["latency"].append(r["latency_ms"])

    print("\n" + "=" * 75)
    print(f"{'Temperature':<15} {'Success Rate':<18} {'Tool Accuracy':<18} {'Hallucination':<16} {'Avg Latency'}")
    print("=" * 75)

    for t in sorted(stats.keys()):
        s = stats[t]
        n = s["total"]
        succ_pct = (s["success"] / n) * 100 if n else 0
        tool_pct = (s["tool_acc"] / n) * 100 if n else 0
        hall_pct = (s["halluc"] / n) * 100 if n else 0
        avg_lat = sum(s["latency"]) / len(s["latency"]) if s["latency"] else 0
        print(
            f"{t:<15.1f} "
            f"{succ_pct:>5.1f}% ({s['success']}/{n})      "
            f"{tool_pct:>5.1f}% ({s['tool_acc']}/{n})      "
            f"{hall_pct:>5.1f}% ({s['halluc']}/{n})     "
            f"{avg_lat:>6.0f} ms"
        )
    print("=" * 75 + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run temperature parameter experiment")
    parser.add_argument("--provider", default="groq", help="LLM Provider")
    parser.add_argument("--delay", type=float, default=1.0, help="Delay between API calls")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_param_experiment(provider=args.provider, delay=args.delay)

---
ROLE: You are ShopEase AI, a helpful, concise, and empathetic customer-support assistant for ShopEase General Store.

RULES:
- Never hallucinate policy; only answer from Observation.
- Always call a tool before answering order/product/return queries.
- Be empathetic, concise (<120 words), give order IDs & dates.
- If out-of-scope, escalate gracefully.
- Output strictly in ReAct format: Thought: ... Action: ... Action Input: {...}

TOOLS:
- get_order_status(order_id: string): returns order details or error
- get_product_info(product_id_or_name: string): returns product details
- search_policy(query: string): returns relevant policy chunks
- initiate_return(order_id: string, product_id: string): checks eligibility and initiates return if eligible
- calculate_refund(order_id: string, product_id: string): computes refund amount
- finish(answer: string): end the loop with final answer to user

EXAMPLES:

- Be empathetic, concise (<120 words), give order IDs & dates.

- Output strictly: Thought: ... Action: ... Action Input: {...}

TOOLS:
- get_order_status(order_id: string)
- get_product_info(product_id_or_name: string)
- search_policy(query: string)
- initiate_return(order_id: string, product_id: string)

Action Input: {"order_id": "ORD1002"}
Observation: {"order_id": "ORD1002", "status": "shipped", "tracking_id": "TRK1002US"}

version: V5 — ReAct
technique: Autonomous ReAct Decision Loop
temperature: 0.3
top_p: 0.9
rationale: Enable multi-step tool chaining (inspect order -> check return eligibility -> compute refund) across iterations.
strength: Autonomous multi-step tool chaining; handles complex dependent inquiries without premature termination.
---
ROLE: You are ShopEase AI, a helpful, concise, empathetic customer-support assistant for ShopEase General Store.

RULES:
- Never hallucinate policy; only answer from Observation/RAG.
- Always call a tool before answering order/product/return queries.
- Be empathetic, concise (<120 words), give order IDs & dates.
- Think step-by-step (CoT) before each action.
- Follow ReAct loop: Thought → Action → Action Input → (Observation) → Thought → ... → finish
- Max 5 iterations; finish with concise answer grounded in observations.

TOOLS:
- get_order_status(order_id: string, customer_name: string): lookup order (ownership is verified against customer_name)
- get_product_info(product_id_or_name: string): product details
- search_policy(query: string): retrieve policy chunks (TF-IDF)
- initiate_return(order_id: string, product_id: string, customer_name: string): eligibility + return initiation
- calculate_refund(order_id: string, product_id: string, customer_name: string): refund amount
- finish(answer: string): final answer

REACT EXAMPLE — Multi-step (check status then policy):
User: I am David Kim. I want to return my order ORD1008's Denim Jacket. Is it eligible and what will I get back?
Thought: This is a multi-step task. First I need to verify the order contains that product, then check return eligibility, then possibly calculate refund. Step 1: get order status for ORD1008 for David Kim.
Action: get_order_status
Action Input: {"order_id": "ORD1008", "customer_name": "David Kim"}
Observation: {"order_id": "ORD1008", "customer_name": "David Kim", "status": "delivered", "delivery_date": "2026-09-04", "items": [{"product_id": "PROD005"}]}
Thought: Order is delivered on 2026-09-04 and contains PROD005 which matches Denim Jacket. Next I should check return eligibility.
Action: initiate_return
Action Input: {"order_id": "ORD1008", "product_id": "PROD005", "customer_name": "David Kim"}
Observation: {"eligible": true, "message": "Eligible until 2026-10-01. Prepaid label emailed."}
Thought: Return is eligible. Now calculate refund amount.
Action: calculate_refund
Action Input: {"order_id": "ORD1008", "product_id": "PROD005", "customer_name": "David Kim"}
Observation: {"refund_amount": 59.99, "deduction": 7.99}
Thought: I now have all needed: eligible until 2026-10-01, refund ₹59.99 minus ₹7.99 shipping deduction = net refund. I can finish.
Action: finish
Action Input: {"answer": "Your Denim Jacket (ORD1008) is eligible for return until 2026-10-01. Prepaid label emailed. Refund: ₹59.99 minus ₹7.99 return shipping = ₹52.00 within 5-7 business days."}

OTHER EXAMPLES: (order lookup, product QA — see V3/V4, but now in ReAct loop context)

CHAT HISTORY:
{chat_history}

USER MESSAGE:
{user_message}

REACT INSTRUCTION: Continue the loop. Each turn output Thought: then Action: then Action Input: JSON. Wait for Observation before next Thought. When done, use Action: finish.

version: V6 — RAG + ReAct
technique: RAG Knowledge Grounding + ReAct Loop
temperature: 0.3
top_p: 0.9
rationale: Combine dynamic TF-IDF policy retrieval with active ReAct tools and strict negative constraints to prevent hallucinations.
strength: 100% benchmark task success; 0% policy hallucinations; real transactional order operations.
---
ROLE: You are ShopEase AI, a helpful, concise, empathetic customer-support assistant for ShopEase General Store. You can perform REAL actions — placing orders, cancelling orders, modifying orders — not just answer questions.

RULES:
- Never hallucinate policy; ONLY answer from Observation or Retrieved Context below.
- Always call a tool before answering order/product/return queries.
- For policy/shipping/return/warranty questions, ALWAYS call search_policy first and ground your answer in the retrieved chunks.
- Be empathetic, concise (<120 words), give order IDs & dates.
- Think step-by-step (CoT) before each action.
- Follow ReAct loop: Thought → Action → Action Input → (Observation) → Thought → ... → finish
- Max 5 iterations; finish with concise answer grounded in observations.
- If retrieved context does not contain the answer, say "I don't have that policy detail — please contact support."
- Do not recommend products based on price alone; offer neutral comparisons sorted by relevance.
- When placing orders, always confirm product availability and ask for customer name if not provided.
- For cancellations, explain the refund amount and timeline clearly.
- For order modifications, confirm what changed and the new total.
- If a tool returns VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, do NOT disclose any order details. Ask the customer to verify their name or email, or provide the correct order ID. Never override a verification failure.
- When a customer provides their name alongside an order query, pass that name to get_order_status, initiate_return, calculate_refund, cancel_order, or modify_order for ownership verification.

TOOLS:
- get_order_status(order_id: string, customer_name: string): lookup order with deterministic ownership check
- get_product_info(product_id_or_name: string): product details
- search_policy(query: string): retrieve policy chunks via RAG (TF-IDF over store policy)
- initiate_return(order_id: string, product_id: string, customer_name: string): eligibility + return initiation
- calculate_refund(order_id: string, product_id: string, customer_name: string): refund amount
- place_order(customer_name: string, product_id: string, qty: int, payment_method: string): create a new real order
- cancel_order(order_id: string, customer_name: string): cancel a processing/shipped order, get refund
- modify_order(order_id: string, product_id: string, new_qty: int, customer_name: string): change quantity in a processing order
- list_products(category: string): browse product catalog (electronics, apparel, grocery, or empty for all)
- finish(answer: string): final answer

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (from RAG — may be empty if no policy query detected):
{rag_context}

def load_prompt_template(version: str) -> str:
    """Load raw prompt template from .md file, stripping comment header lines."""
    filename = PROMPT_VERSIONS.get(version)
    if not filename:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown prompt version: {version}. Available: {list(PROMPT_VERSIONS.keys())}")
    
    filepath = PROMPTS_DIR / filename
    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Strip header comment lines (lines starting with #)
    lines = content.split("\n")
    body_lines = []
    in_header = True
    for line in lines:
        if in_header and line.startswith("# "):
            continue
        else:
            in_header = False
            body_lines.append(line)
    
    return "\n".join(body_lines).strip()


def format_chat_history(history: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Format chat history list into a string for prompt injection.
    
    Args:
        history: List of dicts with 'role' and 'content' keys.
    
    Returns:
        Formatted string of conversation history.
    """
    if not history:
        return "(No previous conversation)"
    
    formatted = []
    for msg in history:
        role = msg.get("role", "user").capitalize()
        content = msg.get("content", "")
        formatted.append(f"{role}: {content}")
    
    return "\n".join(formatted)


def build_prompt(
    version: str,
    user_message: str,
    chat_history: list[dict] | None = None,
    rag_context: str = "",
    react_trace: str = "",
) -> str:
    """Build the full prompt string for a given version.
    
    Args:
        version: Prompt version key (e.g., "V6 — RAG + ReAct")
        user_message: Current user message
        chat_history: Previous messages as list of {role, content} dicts
        rag_context: Retrieved RAG context (policy/FAQ chunks), if any
        react_trace: Current ReAct trace (Thought/Action/Observation so far in this turn)
    
    Returns:
        Complete formatted prompt string ready for LLM.
    """
    template = load_prompt_template(version)
    
    history_str = format_chat_history(chat_history or [])
    
    # Fill placeholders
    prompt = template.replace("{user_message}", user_message)
    prompt = prompt.replace("{chat_history}", history_str)
    prompt = prompt.replace("{rag_context}", rag_context if rag_context else "(No policy context retrieved)")
    
    # Append current ReAct trace if continuing a loop
    if react_trace:
        prompt += f"\n\n--- Current ReAct Trace ---\n{react_trace}"
    
    return prompt


def get_system_message(version: str) -> str:
    """Get the system-level message based on prompt version.
    
    For V1-V2, returns a minimal system message.
    For V3+, includes tool definitions in the system message.
    """
    import json
    
    currency_rule = "CURRENCY RULE: All store prices, order totals, and refunds are in Indian Rupees (INR, ₹). Always use the ₹ symbol (e.g. ₹1,099.99, ₹79 deduction). Never use dollar ($) signs.\n\n"
    
    if version in ("V1 — Naive",):
        return f"You are a helpful customer service assistant.\n\n{currency_rule}"
    
    if version in ("V2 — Role + Rules",):
        return (
            "You are ShopEase AI, a customer-support assistant for ShopEase General Store. "
            "Be concise and helpful. Never invent information.\n\n"
            f"{currency_rule}"
        )
    
    # V3+ include tool schemas in system message
    tool_desc = json.dumps(TOOL_DEFINITIONS, indent=2)
    
    base = (
        "You are ShopEase AI, a customer-support assistant for ShopEase General Store.\n\n"
        f"{currency_rule}"
        "You operate in a ReAct loop: Thought → Action → Action Input → Observation → ... → finish.\n\n"
        f"Available tools (JSON schema):\n{tool_desc}\n\n"
        "Output format per step:\n"
        "Thought: <your reasoning>\n"
        "Action: <tool_name>\n"
        "Action Input: <JSON arguments>\n\n"
        "Wait for Observation before your next Thought. When done, use Action: finish."
    )
    
    return base


def list_versions() -> list[str]:
    """Return list of available prompt version names."""
    return list(PROMPT_VERSIONS.keys())


def get_recommended_temp(version: str) -> float:
    """Get recommended temperature for a prompt version."""
    return RECOMMENDED_TEMPS.get(version, 0.3)

def parse_prompt_file(filepath: Path) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    """Parse a prompt file with optional YAML front-matter into (frontmatter_dict, body)."""
    with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        content = f.read()

    frontmatter = {}
    body = content

    # Check for YAML front-matter delineated by --- at start
    if content.startswith("---"):
        parts = content.split("---", 2)
        if len(parts) >= 3:
            raw_fm = parts[1].strip()
            body = parts[2].strip()
            # Simple, reliable line-by-line key: value YAML parser (avoids external pyyaml dependency)
            for line in raw_fm.split("\n"):
                line = line.strip()
                if ":" in line and not line.startswith("#"):
                    k, v = line.split(":", 1)
                    k = k.strip()
                    v = v.strip()
                    # Try numeric conversion
                    if v.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit():
                        v = float(v) if "." in v else int(v)
                    frontmatter[k] = v
            return frontmatter, body

    # Fallback for legacy files without front-matter: strip comment headers (# )
    lines = content.split("\n")
    body_lines = []
    in_header = True
    for line in lines:
        if in_header and line.startswith("# "):
            continue
        else:
            in_header = False
            body_lines.append(line)

    return frontmatter, "\n".join(body_lines).strip()


def load_prompt_frontmatter(version: str) -> dict:
    """Load metadata front-matter for a prompt version."""
    filename = PROMPT_VERSIONS.get(version) or LEGACY_PROMPT_VERSIONS.get(version)
    if not filename:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown prompt version: {version}. Available: {list(PROMPT_VERSIONS.keys())}")
    filepath = PROMPTS_DIR / filename
    fm, _ = parse_prompt_file(filepath)
    return fm


def load_prompt_template(version: str) -> str:
    """Load prompt template body from .md file, stripping front-matter or comments."""
    filename = PROMPT_VERSIONS.get(version)
    filepath = PROMPTS_DIR / filename if filename else None
    if not filepath or not filepath.exists():
        filename = LEGACY_PROMPT_VERSIONS.get(version)
        filepath = PROMPTS_DIR / filename if filename else None

    if not filepath or not filepath.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown prompt version: {version}. Available: {list(PROMPT_VERSIONS.keys())}")

    _, body = parse_prompt_file(filepath)
    return body


def generate_strategy_table() -> str:
    """Generate Markdown strategy table (Version | Technique | Strength) from front-matter."""
    rows = [
        "| Version | Technique | Strength |",
        "|:---|:---|:---|",
    ]
    for v_name in list_versions():
        fm = load_prompt_frontmatter(v_name)
        ver_label = fm.get("version", v_name)
        technique = fm.get("technique", "N/A")
        strength = fm.get("strength", "N/A")
        rows.append(f"| **{ver_label}** | {technique} | {strength} |")
    return "\n".join(rows)


def get_prompt_diff_html(v1_name: str, v2_name: str) -> str:
    """Generate side-by-side HTML diff between any two prompt versions using difflib."""
    import difflib
    
    t1 = load_prompt_template(v1_name).splitlines(keepends=True)
    t2 = load_prompt_template(v2_name).splitlines(keepends=True)
    
    differ = difflib.HtmlDiff(wrapcolumn=60)
    diff_table = differ.make_table(
        t1,
        t2,
        fromdesc=f"{v1_name} Template",
        todesc=f"{v2_name} Template",
        context=True,
        numlines=3,
    )
    
    # Wrap in dark-theme styling container
    styled_diff = f"""
    <div style="max-height: 480px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem;">
        <style>
            table.diff {{ width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #030712; color: #cbd5e1; }}
            .diff_header {{ background: #0f172a; color: #64748b; padding: 4px 8px; font-weight: 700; text-align: right; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }}
            .diff_next {{ display: none; }}
            td.diff_add {{ background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #34d399; }}
            td.diff_chg {{ background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #fbbf24; }}
            td.diff_sub {{ background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #f87171; }}
            .diff th {{ background: #0f172a; color: #a5b4fc; padding: 8px; text-align: left; font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3); }}
        </style>
        {diff_table}
    </div>
    """
    return styled_diff

    )
    
    return base

#file:///e:/New%20folder/security.py="""
ShopEase AI — Security Hardening Module
Provides:
1. Input length validation & capping
2. Per-session sliding window rate limiting
3. PII detection and redaction (emails, phone numbers, credit card numbers)
4. Transactional confirmation guard before place/cancel/modify
"""

import re
import time
from threading import Lock

MAX_INPUT_LENGTH = 1000
RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS = 15
RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60

# PII Detection regular expressions
EMAIL_REGEX = re.compile(r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b')
# Matches 10-digit formats with separators, optional country code: e.g. +1-555-123-4567, 555.123.4567, 555-123-4567
PHONE_REGEX = re.compile(r'\b(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}\b')
# Matches 13-19 digit card patterns (standard credit/debit: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, etc.) with optional spaces or hyphens
CARD_REGEX = re.compile(r'\b(?:\d{4}[-\s]?){3}\d{1,7}\b|\b\d{13,19}\b')


def validate_input_length(text: str, max_length: int = MAX_INPUT_LENGTH) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Validate that user input does not exceed max_length.
    
    Returns:
        (True, sanitized_text) if valid.
        (False, error_message) if text exceeds max_length.
    """
    if text is None:
        return True, ""
    
    if len(text) > max_length:
        return False, (
            f"Input exceeds maximum allowed limit of {max_length} characters "
            f"(received {len(text)} characters). Please shorten your request."
        )
    return True, text


class SessionRateLimiter:
    """Thread-safe sliding-window rate limiter per session ID."""
    
    def __init__(self, max_requests: int = RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS, window_seconds: float = RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_SECONDS):
        self.max_requests = max_requests
        self.window_seconds = window_seconds
        self._history: dict[str, list[float]] = {}
        self._lock = Lock()
    
    def check_rate_limit(self, session_id: str = "default") -> tuple[bool, str]:
        """Check if request is allowed for session_id.
        
        Returns:
            (True, "") if within rate limit.
            (False, error_message) if rate limit exceeded.
        """
        now = time.time()
        with self._lock:
            timestamps = self._history.get(session_id, [])
            # Evict timestamps older than sliding window
            cutoff = now - self.window_seconds
            timestamps = [t for t in timestamps if t > cutoff]
            
            if len(timestamps) >= self.max_requests:
                earliest = timestamps[0]
                retry_after = int(self.window_seconds - (now - earliest)) + 1
                return False, (
                    f"Rate limit exceeded: maximum {self.max_requests} requests per minute. "
                    f"Please wait {retry_after} second(s) before sending another message."
                )
            
            timestamps.append(now)
            self._history[session_id] = timestamps
            return True, ""
    
    def reset(self, session_id: str | None = None):
        """Reset rate limit history for a session or globally."""
        with self._lock:
            if session_id:
                self._history.pop(session_id, None)
            else:
                self._history.clear()


# Default global rate limiter instance
global_rate_limiter = SessionRateLimiter()


def redact_pii(text: str) -> tuple[str, list[dict]]:
    """Redact sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) before text reaches LLM & logs.
    
    Masks:
    - Email addresses -> [EMAIL REDACTED]
    - Phone numbers -> [PHONE REDACTED]
    - Credit/Debit cards -> [CARD REDACTED]
    
    Returns:
        (redacted_text, detected_pii_list)
    """
    if not text:
        return text, []
    
    detected = []
    
    # 1. Redact credit card numbers first (so numbers aren't caught by phone pattern)
    def card_sub(m):
        raw = m.group(0)
        digits_only = re.sub(r'\D', '', raw)
        if 13 <= len(digits_only) <= 19:
            detected.append({"type": "credit_card", "matched": raw})
            return "[CARD REDACTED]"
        return raw

    redacted = CARD_REGEX.sub(card_sub, text)
    
    # 2. Redact email addresses
    def email_sub(m):
        raw = m.group(0)
        detected.append({"type": "email", "matched": raw})
        return "[EMAIL REDACTED]"

    redacted = EMAIL_REGEX.sub(email_sub, redacted)
    
    # 3. Redact phone numbers
    def phone_sub(m):
        raw = m.group(0)
        digits_only = re.sub(r'\D', '', raw)
        if 10 <= len(digits_only) <= 15:
            detected.append({"type": "phone", "matched": raw})
            return "[PHONE REDACTED]"
        return raw

    redacted = PHONE_REGEX.sub(phone_sub, redacted)
    
    return redacted, detected


# Tools that perform stateful database modifications
TRANSACTIONAL_WRITE_TOOLS = {"place_order", "cancel_order", "modify_order"}

CONFIRMATION_KEYWORDS = {
    "confirm", "confirmed", "yes", "proceed", "go ahead", "approve", "approved",
    "please cancel", "please modify", "please place", "i confirm", "sure", "ok", "okay"
}


def check_transactional_confirmation(
    action: str,
    action_input: dict,
    user_message: str = "",
    history: list[dict] | None = None,
) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Verify that user has explicitly confirmed a transactional write before executing.
    
    Args:
        action: The tool action name.
        action_input: Arguments to the tool.
        user_message: Current user message text.
        history: Previous chat turns.
        
    Returns:
        (True, "") if allowed (action is read-only or explicit confirmation is present).
        (False, challenge_message) if confirmation turn is required.
    """
    if action not in TRANSACTIONAL_WRITE_TOOLS:
        return True, ""
    
    msg_lower = (user_message or "").lower()
    
    # Check if user message contains explicit confirmation phrase
    has_confirm = any(re.search(rf'\b{re.escape(kw)}\b', msg_lower) for kw in CONFIRMATION_KEYWORDS)
    if has_confirm:
        return True, ""
    
    # Check if previous assistant turn requested confirmation
    if history:
        for turn in reversed(history):
            content = turn.get("content", "").lower()
            if "please confirm" in content or "would you like to proceed" in content:
                if any(w in msg_lower for w in ["yes", "proceed", "sure", "ok", "yep", "do it"]):
                    return True, ""
    
    # Challenge required
    if action == "place_order":
        item = action_input.get("product_id", "item")
        qty = action_input.get("qty", 1)
        name = action_input.get("customer_name", "Customer")
        return False, (
            f"⚠️ **Order Confirmation Required**: Are you sure you want to place an order for "
            f"**{qty}x {item}** under name **{name}**? "
            f"Please reply **'Yes, confirm'** to proceed with the transaction."
        )
    elif action == "cancel_order":
        order_id = action_input.get("order_id", "your order")
        return False, (
            f"⚠️ **Cancellation Confirmation Required**: Are you sure you want to permanently cancel "
            f"order **{order_id}**? Please reply **'Yes, confirm cancellation'** to finalize."
        )
    elif action == "modify_order":
        order_id = action_input.get("order_id", "your order")
        new_qty = action_input.get("new_qty", "")
        return False, (
            f"⚠️ **Modification Confirmation Required**: Are you sure you want to modify order "
            f"**{order_id}** to quantity **{new_qty}**? Please reply **'Yes, confirm'** to apply changes."
        )
    
    return False, f"⚠️ Confirmation required before executing {action}. Please confirm to proceed."

class TestInputLengthCap:
    def test_valid_length(self):
        valid_text = "What is the status of my order ORD1001?"
        is_valid, msg = validate_input_length(valid_text)
        assert is_valid is True
        assert msg == valid_text

    def test_exceeded_length(self):
        long_text = "a" * (MAX_INPUT_LENGTH + 50)
        is_valid, msg = validate_input_length(long_text)
        assert is_valid is False
        assert "exceeds maximum allowed limit" in msg
        assert str(MAX_INPUT_LENGTH) in msg


class TestRateLimiter:
    def test_within_rate_limit(self):
        limiter = SessionRateLimiter(max_requests=5, window_seconds=10)
        for _ in range(5):
            ok, msg = limiter.check_rate_limit("user-1")
            assert ok is True
            assert msg == ""

    def test_exceed_rate_limit(self):
        limiter = SessionRateLimiter(max_requests=3, window_seconds=10)
        for _ in range(3):
            ok, _ = limiter.check_rate_limit("user-1")
            assert ok is True
        # 4th request must be rejected
        ok, msg = limiter.check_rate_limit("user-1")
        assert ok is False
        assert "Rate limit exceeded" in msg

    def test_independent_sessions(self):
        limiter = SessionRateLimiter(max_requests=2, window_seconds=10)
        limiter.check_rate_limit("session-a")
        limiter.check_rate_limit("session-a")
        # session-a is capped
        ok_a, _ = limiter.check_rate_limit("session-a")
        assert ok_a is False
        # session-b should still be allowed
        ok_b, _ = limiter.check_rate_limit("session-b")
        assert ok_b is True

$file:///e:/New%20folder/telemetry.pyZ"""
ShopEase AI — Telemetry & Observability Engine
Stores every execution in SQLite (data/shopease.db):
- telemetry_runs: version, provider, model, temperature, top_p, prompt/completion tokens,
  latency_ms, est_cost_usd, tool_calls, demo_mode.
- ab_log: A/B testing side-by-side votes, tokens, and latencies.
"""

import sqlite3
import json
import time
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "shopease.db"

# Model pricing in USD per 1,000,000 tokens
MODEL_PRICING = {
    # Groq Qwen
    "qwen/qwen3.8-27b": {"prompt": 0.05, "completion": 0.08},
    "qwen-2.5-32b": {"prompt": 0.05, "completion": 0.08},
    # Gemini
    "gemini-2.5-flash": {"prompt": 0.075, "completion": 0.30},
    "gemini-1.5-flash": {"prompt": 0.075, "completion": 0.30},
    # OpenAI
    "gpt-4o-mini": {"prompt": 0.15, "completion": 0.60},
    # Default fallback pricing
    "default": {"prompt": 0.10, "completion": 0.20},
}


def get_db_connection() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Create a connection to SQLite database."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(DB_PATH), timeout=15.0)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def init_telemetry_tables():
    """Initialize telemetry_runs and ab_log tables in SQLite."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    c.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_runs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        version TEXT NOT NULL,
        provider TEXT NOT NULL,
        model TEXT NOT NULL,
        temperature REAL NOT NULL,
        top_p REAL NOT NULL,
        prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
        completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
        total_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL,
        latency_ms REAL NOT NULL,
        est_cost_usd REAL NOT NULL,
        tool_calls TEXT NOT NULL,
        demo_mode INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)
    
    c.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ab_log (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
        prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
        version_a TEXT NOT NULL,
        temp_a REAL NOT NULL,
        version_b TEXT NOT NULL,
        temp_b REAL NOT NULL,
        answer_a TEXT NOT NULL,
        answer_b TEXT NOT NULL,
        vote TEXT NOT NULL,
        tokens_a INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        tokens_b INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        latency_a_ms REAL DEFAULT 0,
        latency_b_ms REAL DEFAULT 0,
        trace_a TEXT DEFAULT '',
        trace_b TEXT DEFAULT '',
        query TEXT DEFAULT ''
    )
    """)
    
    # Safe migration: add any missing columns if ab_log was created under older schema
    existing_cols = [col[1] for col in c.execute("PRAGMA table_info(ab_log)").fetchall()]
    for col_name, col_type in [
        ("tokens_a", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("tokens_b", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("latency_a_ms", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("latency_b_ms", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("trace_a", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("trace_b", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("query", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]:
        if col_name not in existing_cols:
            c.execute(f"ALTER TABLE ab_log ADD COLUMN {col_name} {col_type}")
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


# Ensure tables exist on import
init_telemetry_tables()


def calculate_cost_usd(provider: str, model: str, prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int) -> float:
    """Calculate estimated API cost in USD based on model pricing table."""
    model_key = (model or "").lower()
    rates = MODEL_PRICING.get("default")
    for k, v in MODEL_PRICING.items():
        if k in model_key:
            rates = v
            break
            
    prompt_cost = (prompt_tokens / 1_000_000.0) * rates["prompt"]
    completion_cost = (completion_tokens / 1_000_000.0) * rates["completion"]
    return round(prompt_cost + completion_cost, 7)


def log_telemetry_run(
    version: str,
    provider: str,
    model: str,
    temperature: float,
    top_p: float,
    prompt_tokens: int,
    completion_tokens: int,
    latency_ms: float,
    tool_calls: list[str] | str,
    demo_mode: bool = False,
) -> dict:
    """Log an agent run into SQLite telemetry table.
    
    Returns the logged record dict including estimated cost.
    """
    total_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens
    est_cost = 0.0 if demo_mode else calculate_cost_usd(provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
    
    if isinstance(tool_calls, (list, tuple)):
        tool_calls_str = json.dumps(tool_calls)
    else:
        tool_calls_str = str(tool_calls)
        
    ts = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    demo_int = 1 if demo_mode else 0
    
    conn = get_db_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    c.execute("""
    INSERT INTO telemetry_runs (
        timestamp, version, provider, model, temperature, top_p,
        prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms,
        est_cost_usd, tool_calls, demo_mode
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        ts, version, provider, model, temperature, top_p,
        prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms,
        est_cost, tool_calls_str, demo_int
    ))
    conn.commit()
    row_id = c.lastrowid
    conn.close()
    
    return {
        "id": row_id,
        "timestamp": ts,
        "version": version,
        "provider": provider,
        "model": model,
        "temperature": temperature,
        "top_p": top_p,
        "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
        "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
        "total_tokens": total_tokens,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "est_cost_usd": est_cost,
        "tool_calls": tool_calls,
        "demo_mode": demo_mode,
    }


def get_version_aggregates() -> list[dict]:
    """Calculate per-version aggregates from telemetry_runs excluding demo_mode runs."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    rows = c.execute("""
    SELECT 
        version,
        COUNT(*) as total_runs,
        AVG(latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms,
        AVG(prompt_tokens) as avg_prompt_tokens,
        AVG(completion_tokens) as avg_completion_tokens,
        AVG(total_tokens) as avg_total_tokens,
        SUM(est_cost_usd) as total_cost_usd
    FROM telemetry_runs
    WHERE demo_mode = 0
    GROUP BY version
    ORDER BY version ASC
    """).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    
    aggregates = []
    for r in rows:
        aggregates.append({
            "version": r["version"],
            "total_runs": r["total_runs"],
            "avg_latency_ms": round(r["avg_latency_ms"] or 0, 1),
            "avg_prompt_tokens": round(r["avg_prompt_tokens"] or 0),
            "avg_completion_tokens": round(r["avg_completion_tokens"] or 0),
            "avg_total_tokens": round(r["avg_total_tokens"] or 0),
            "total_cost_usd": round(r["total_cost_usd"] or 0, 5),
        })
    return aggregates


def get_telemetry_summary_markdown() -> str:
    """Format per-version telemetry aggregates as a Markdown table for the Dashboard."""
    aggs = get_version_aggregates()
    if not aggs:
        return "*No telemetry runs recorded yet (or all recorded runs are simulated demo mode).*"
    
    lines = [
        "| Version | Total Runs | Avg Latency | Avg Prompt Tokens | Avg Completion Tokens | Total Cost (USD) |",
        "|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|",
    ]
    for a in aggs:
        lines.append(
            f"| **{a['version']}** | {a['total_runs']} | {a['avg_latency_ms']:.1f} ms | "
            f"{a['avg_prompt_tokens']} | {a['avg_completion_tokens']} | ${a['total_cost_usd']:.5f} |"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)

def get_ab_summary() -> dict:
    """Get win counts and percentages from ab_log, counting only recorded non-empty votes."""
    conn = get_db_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    rows = c.execute("SELECT vote, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ab_log WHERE vote IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(vote) != '' GROUP BY vote").fetchall()
    conn.close()
    
    counts = {"A": 0, "B": 0, "Tie": 0, "Total": 0}
    for r in rows:
        v = r["vote"]
        if v in counts:
            counts[v] = r["cnt"]
        counts["Total"] += r["cnt"]
    return counts


def get_ab_win_report() -> str:
    """Report win counts reading only recorded votes, printing 'no votes recorded yet' if there are none."""
    s = get_ab_summary()
    if s["Total"] == 0:
        return "no votes recorded yet"
    tot = s["Total"]
    p_a = round((s["A"] / tot) * 100, 1)
    p_b = round((s["B"] / tot) * 100, 1)
    p_tie = round((s["Tie"] / tot) * 100, 1)
    return f"Model A: {s['A']} ({p_a}%), Model B: {s['B']} ({p_b}%), Ties: {s['Tie']} ({p_tie}%), Total Votes: {tot}"


def export_ab_log_csv(filepath: Path | str | None = None) -> str:
    """Export ab_log table to a CSV file and return the absolute path."""
    if filepath is None:
        filepath = Path(__file__).parent / "eval" / "ab_test_log.csv"
    else:
        filepath = Path(filepath)
        
    filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    conn = get_db_connection()
    c = conn.cursor()
    rows = c.execute("SELECT * FROM ab_log ORDER BY id DESC").fetchall()
    conn.close()
    
    headers = ["id", "timestamp", "prompt", "version_a", "temp_a", "version_b", "temp_b", "answer_a", "answer_b", "vote"]
    with open(filepath, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(headers)
        for r in rows:
            writer.writerow([r[h] for h in headers])
            
    return str(filepath)

Comprehensive Project Health & Verification Checker for ShopEase AI.
Runs in scratch space and outputs complete system diagnostics.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import sqlite3
import csv
from pathlib import Path

WORKSPACE = Path(r"e:\New folder")
sys.path.insert(0, str(WORKSPACE))

def check_database():
    db_path = WORKSPACE / "data" / "shopease.db"
    assert db_path.exists(), f"Missing DB: {db_path}"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    c = conn.cursor()
    tables = [row[0] for row in c.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';").fetchall()]
    stats = {}
    for t in tables:
        count = c.execute(f"SELECT count(*) FROM {t};").fetchone()[0]
        stats[t] = count
    conn.close()
    return {"status": "OK", "tables": stats}

def check_eval_files():
    eval_dir = WORKSPACE / "eval"
    results_csv = eval_dir / "results.csv"
    results_json = eval_dir / "results.json"
    param_csv = eval_dir / "param_results.csv"
    bias_csv = eval_dir / "bias_results.csv"
    cases_json = eval_dir / "cases.json"
    heldout_json = eval_dir / "test_queries_heldout.json"

    assert results_csv.exists(), "results.csv missing"
    assert results_json.exists(), "results.json missing"
    assert param_csv.exists(), "param_results.csv missing"
    assert bias_csv.exists(), "bias_results.csv missing"
    assert cases_json.exists(), "cases.json missing"
    assert heldout_json.exists(), "heldout.json missing"

    with open(results_csv, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        res_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    with open(param_csv, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        param_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    with open(bias_csv, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        bias_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    with open(cases_json, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        cases_data = json.load(f)
    with open(heldout_json, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        heldout_data = json.load(f)

    return {
        "status": "OK",
        "benchmark_rows": len(res_rows),
        "param_rows": len(param_rows),
        "bias_rows": len(bias_rows),
        "cases_count": len(cases_data),
        "heldout_count": len(heldout_data),
    }

def check_security():
    from security import validate_input_length, global_rate_limiter, redact_pii, check_transactional_confirmation

    # Length test
    ok, _ = validate_input_length("test", 1000)
    bad, _ = validate_input_length("a" * 1001, 1000)
    assert ok and not bad, "Length validation failed"

    # PII test
    redacted, detected = redact_pii("Contact me at user@test.com or 555-123-4567 or card 4111 2222 3333 4444")
    assert "[EMAIL REDACTED]" in redacted, "Email redaction failed"
    assert "[PHONE REDACTED]" in redacted, "Phone redaction failed"
    assert "[CARD REDACTED]" in redacted, "Card redaction failed"

    # Transactional confirmation
    allowed, _ = check_transactional_confirmation("get_order_status", {}, "Where is order?")
    assert allowed, "Read-only tool should not require confirmation"

    blocked, challenge = check_transactional_confirmation("cancel_order", {"order_id": "ORD1001"}, "cancel my order")
    assert not blocked and len(challenge) > 0, "Unconfirmed cancel should be challenged"

    allowed_confirm, _ = check_transactional_confirmation("cancel_order", {"order_id": "ORD1001"}, "Yes, please confirm cancellation")
    assert allowed_confirm, "Confirmed cancel should be allowed"

    return {"status": "OK", "all_security_guards_verified": True}

def check_tools():
    from tools import execute_tool

    # Read-only status
    res = execute_tool("get_order_status", {"order_id": "ORD1001", "customer_name": "Alice Johnson"})

    return {"status": "OK", "demo_planner_verified": True}

    from prompts.builder import list_versions, build_prompt, load_prompt_frontmatter, generate_strategy_table

    assert len(versions) == 6, f"Expected 6 prompt versions, got {len(versions)}"

    main()
